extracted.intended_audience: researchers and organizations seeking NCI/NIH grant funding (cancer researchers, grant applicants)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for locating National Cancer Institute (NCI) and NIH notices of funding opportunities (NOFOs) and related policy notices so applicants can identify appropriate grant programs and ensure compliance with current policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official sources for NOFOs
rubrics_metrics.description: The NIH posts all notices of funding opportunities (NOFOs) on grants.gov and grants.nih.gov, the NIH’s single official source for grant and cooperative agreement funding opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use grants.gov and grants.nih.gov as the authoritative places to find NOFOs for NIH and NCI funding; do not rely on unofficial third-party listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the NIH Grant search tool for NCI opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the NIH Grant search tool to find opportunities for NCI funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To browse all NIH grant opportunities, clear the 'NCI' preset filter. Use the search tool filters to target NCI-specific funding or broaden to NIH-wide opportunities as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Align proposals with NCI research priorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore NCI Research Priorities by reviewing NCI Interest Areas and Highlighted Topics to learn about NCI priorities for cancer research and support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before applying, consult Interest Areas and Highlighted Topics to ensure your project aligns with NCI priorities and to identify topic-specific funding announcements or emphasis areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor policy notices and updates via NIH Guide
rubrics_metrics.description: Find specific notices of policies, guidelines, and other information in the NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts. Users can subscribe for updates on this page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regularly check and subscribe to the NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts to stay current on policy changes, application requirements, and other notices that may affect proposal preparation and submission.
